name: M-days Doukoku no Koubi Jigoku
source:
In the future, where the world is destructed by wars.
Number of men is decreased and the female warriors called Amazoness rule the world.
There, the protagonist gets caught by two Amazoness warriors.
Restraint in a dark underground room, he becomes a sex slave to them...
